title: Fuzzy Control of Pressure in a Water Supply Network Based on Neural Network System Modeling and IoT Measurements
summary: An ANN surrogate trained on 15 days of water-network readings enabled pre-field testing of a fuzzy controller, which was then applied at a real pumping station for two days; first-day estimated energy use was 27.6 kWh/day lower than the incumbent control. A second-day communication delay caused instability, so this is a short field pilot. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
